purpose: the exact Windows CI artifacts whose transferred bytes are verified by packaging/verify_artifact_bytes.py; every expected value below was read before any byte of the archive was downloaded, from sources that do not depend on those bytes

expected_value_sources.run: GET /repos/asgareyvazi/Drill-master/actions/runs/<run_id> and /jobs: run number, attempt, head_sha, conclusion of every job
expected_value_sources.archive: GET /repos/asgareyvazi/Drill-master/actions/artifacts/<artifact_id>: name, size_in_bytes, digest (computed by GitHub at upload), workflow_run.id, workflow_run.head_sha
expected_value_sources.inner: the 'Windows release manifest' notice published by the build job of the same run: installer and portable ZIP filename, size and SHA-256, tests, lifecycle and signing state

scope_rule: a match covers the one artifact named in its entry and nothing else; a regenerated, later or earlier artifact needs its own entry with independently sourced values

candidates.role: primary: built from the exact branch tip at the start of M42.14, with both mandatory gates green on that SHA
secondary: the M42.13 documented candidate, built from the last code and record checkpoint; the release code is identical to the primary (the later commit adds only a dated report)
